order_param_is_memory_copy.meaning: the order parameter passed to _updateLimitPostOrder is a memory variable (temporary copy), not storage

previous_tail_exists.meaning: a previous tail order exists in the limit price level to which the new order is being linked

new_order_prev_link_stored.meaning: in storage, the new order's backward link (prevOrderId) points to the previous tail order

orders_unfillable.meaning: orders become unfillable due to broken links

assumptions: The order book is a doubly-linked list of limit orders and _updateLimitPostOrder is the linking step.
The previous tail order is the order immediately preceding the new order at the same limit price level.
The report's bidirectional-link requirement applies to the storage state of the new order's prevOrderId.

unresolved.description: The report does not give a numeric or structural definition of the storage prevOrderId value versus the memory copy value; the correspondence is represented only by the grounded Boolean new_order_prev_link_stored.
Report does not state whether the previous tail order is the head or a non-head order, nor any caller/authorization condition for _updateLimitPostOrder.

limitations: Only the orders_become_unfillable impact is formalized; other listed impacts are handled in separate claim-generation passes.
The link correspondence is encoded as a grounded Boolean because the report supplies no concrete order-ID values.
The condition narrows to the reported scenario where a previous tail order exists and the order parameter is a memory copy.
